description.value: Shanghai Mandarin is a Chinese restaurant in Kamloops serving a broad menu of Cantonese and Mandarin-style dishes including Beijing Lemon Chicken, Braised Duck, and Prawns with Bean Cakes. Located in a strip mall on Summit Drive, it offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, and catering for groups of all sizes. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient full-service meal stop with online ordering available.
